evidence.quote: Many FOMC participants now see that the case for a somewhat more accommodative policy has strengthened.
The projections of appropriate policy show that many participants believe that some cut in the federal funds rate will be appropriate in the scenario that they see as most likely.
participants expressed concerns about a more sustained shortfall of inflation.

many FOMC participants cited the investment picture and weaker business sentiment and the crosscurrents I mentioned earlier as supporting their judgment that the risk of less favorable outcomes has risen.
And we will act as needed, including promptly, if that's appropriate, and use our tools to expand—to sustain the expansion.
we'll always be willing to adjust balance sheet policy so that it serves our dual-mandate objectives.

parsed.rationale: Rates were held, but the Chair signals a strengthened case for cuts, with many participants projecting cuts and a readiness to act promptly. He stresses muted inflation, falling inflation expectations and rising downside risks, even as the consumer and labor market remain solid.
